remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Depicts Leah Harris, a food demonstrator in southwestern Texas, with whom O'Keeffe became friends in 1917, on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. When O'Keeffe took a leave of absence from her teaching position in early 1918, she and Leah moved to San Antonio, and later that spring, to the Harris family farm in Waring, Texas, where O'Keeffe made this drawing and cat. no. 242. Verso of cat. no. 235. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: relationship of image to cat. no. 242.
titles.title: Untitled (Leah)
